phase_name: Production Promotion Readiness & Final Deployment Decision

formal_decision.justification: E6b demonstrates strong technical capability (+100% Devanagari Hit@5, +220% MRR, 94.3% latency reduction, 0 Latin regressions, 100% claim precision across audited answers), but cannot be promoted to production due to: (1) statistical underpowering (N=45 answerable intents, power=65.37%, exact p=0.6250), (2) low absolute Devanagari recall (8.89%), (3) downstream Evidence Controller false rejection (3/4 hits rejected: Q010, Q014, Q030 due to uncalibrated CECI thresholds), and (4) absence of production configuration/telemetry exposure.

assessment.description: Comprehensive 9-section production readiness assessment covering retrieval quality, statistical power, end-to-end quality, computational efficiency, operational integration, and comparative decision framework.

risk_register.description: Detailed 10-risk operational and statistical risk register covering retrieval reliability, regressions, false abstention, hallucination, regulatory mistakes, citation failures, latency, resources, sample size, and operational fallback.

production_decision.description: Formal executive production decision memo adopting RETAIN_AS_EXPERIMENTAL, specifying strongest supporting evidence, counter-evidence, explicit M11 conditions, and formal closure of Milestone M10.

final_consistency_audit.description: Documentation-only consistency audit reconciling Devanagari query attribution, claim-grounding denominators, statistical language, the provisional 50% target, and resource qualification.

evidence_inventory.description: Machine-readable evidence inventory capturing SHA-256 hashes of 17 core repository artifacts and verified metric summaries.

m11_prerequisites.confirmatory_intent_groups: 225 - 230 independent intent groups (900 - 920 total queries across 4 languages)
m11_prerequisites.controller_remedy: Script-aware calibrated CECI thresholds in EvidenceController to eliminate downstream false abstention
m11_prerequisites.retrieval_target: Provisional M11 aspirational target: Devanagari Hit@5 >= 50% via hybrid dense-sparse transliteration indexing
m11_prerequisites.operationalization: Expose RETRIEVAL_RERANK_STRATEGY in config.py, QueryRequest schemas, and Prometheus metrics
